=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:486-540 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: An ambiguous droplet create (status 0) reserves a cap and breaker slot but is not counted in `booting[repo]` or `created_here`, so the `queued_without_supply` alert check still sees no supply.
  WHY: If DigitalOcean accepted the create and the queue is past the alert threshold, a false `queued_without_supply:<repo>` alert fires in the same pass. Reviewers rated it NIT, so low is used.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:_process_pending_reruns (budget comment in tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/__main__.py:28-34) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Every pending lost-runner re-run is retried on every pass, up to 10 per pass, with no per-job backoff, and the documented "about 3,450 an hour" budget omits these calls.
  WHY: During mass droplet loss the extra calls, up to about 2,400 an hour, can exhaust the shared 5,000-an-hour limit and trigger `RateLimited`.
- tests/test_runner_scaler_bootstrap.py:N/A | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The test suite fails in the CI environment because PyYAML is not installed in the sandbox.
  WHY: Bootstrap and config changes could ship unvalidated. Severity is MAJOR from this reviewer only. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 said the failure also occurs on the merge-base and is a sandbox issue, not a PR defect, so it did not carry it over.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: Step 6(c) part 2 of `/seed-repo`: if the `started` line shows `dry_run=true`, stop before part 3, leave `PIPELINE_RUNS_ON` unset, and report `pending scaler dry run`. The status needs a documented resolution path (flipping `RUNNER_SCALER_DRY_RUN` to false, then finishing part 3).
  expected_change_site: "Remaining checklist (user)" block (item 5, line 58) in `.claude/commands/seed-repo.md` and `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/seed-repo.md` (minimax_minimax-m3 also names the README.md onboarding section)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Checklist item 5 covers only the App-install hand-off and has no step for the `pending scaler dry run` state. It does not say who flips `RUNNER_SCALER_DRY_RUN` to false or how part 3 finishes. README.md's onboarding section also stops at "check that the redeploy shows dry_run=false". Severity disagreement: MAJOR from google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, NIT from the others.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:`_create_for_demand` (`queued_without_supply` check) and `_create` ambiguous branch | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: After a create that got no response, `_create` stores the droplet in `self.created` and returns False. `_create_for_demand` takes a cap and breaker slot, but the alert check still uses `booting[repo] == 0 and created_here == 0`.
  WHY: If the queued job is older than `queue_alert_minutes`, a false `queued_without_supply:<repo>` fires once per incident. Only the alert text is affected.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:`_process_pending_reruns` (`self.github.rerun_job`), budget comment in tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/__main__.py lines 28-34 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Every pending lost-runner re-run is retried on every pass, up to 10 per pass, so up to about 2,400 calls an hour, and the "about 3,450 an hour" budget omits them.
  WHY: Mass droplet loss could exhaust the shared 5,000-an-hour limit and cause `RateLimited`, which delays droplet creation.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Step 6(c) part 2 of `/seed-repo`: on `dry_run=true`, stop before part 3, leave `PIPELINE_RUNS_ON` unset, and report `pending scaler dry run`.
  Expected change site: "Remaining checklist (user)" block in `.claude/commands/seed-repo.md` and `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/seed-repo.md`.
  Evidence of absence: Checklist item 5 covers only the "pending App install" hand-off. No line covers `pending scaler dry run`, such as who flips `RUNNER_SCALER_DRY_RUN` or how part 3 finishes.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Step 6(c) part 2 of `.claude/commands/seed-repo.md` and its byte-identical `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/seed-repo.md` copy introduces the status `pending scaler dry run`, and the PR description lists it as a valid `DigitalOcean runners` status. A consumer still in dry run needs documented recovery instructions: flip `RUNNER_SCALER_DRY_RUN` to false, re-check the redeploy, then re-run the session to set `PIPELINE_RUNS_ON`.
  Expected change site: checklist item 5 of `.claude/commands/seed-repo.md` line 58 and `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/seed-repo.md` line 58, plus the "Remaining checklist (user)" block in `README.md`'s onboarding section.
  Evidence of absence: Checklist item 5 describes only the App-install handoff and never mentions flipping `RUNNER_SCALER_DRY_RUN` or how part 3 finishes. README.md's "Onboarding a consumer" section stops at "check that the redeploy shows dry_run=false" without saying what to do if the check fails.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Notes (no distinct findings): (1) `_process_pending_reruns` retries every pending entry each pass, so the "3,450 an hour" budget omits the rerun path. (2) `_create_for_demand` queue-alert check does not count a same-pass ambiguous create as booting, allowing a false `queued_without_supply:<repo>`. Both were recorded as other reviewers' out-of-scope concerns.

Nothing says who flips `RUNNER_SCALER_DRY_RUN` from true to false (tools/runner_scaler/app.yaml ships it as "true") or that part 3 proceeds only after a `started` line shows `dry_run=false`. The Config status line (line 51) lists the status, but the checklist has no resolution step.
